turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-customer metric, so I cannot give a per-customer figure or rank countries on it; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) and Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order), which I did not divide myself. For 1-30 September 2026 by customer country, Revenue (EUR) and Active customers were: DE 2665.5 EUR and 2, FR 1241.0 EUR and 1, GB 2634.0 EUR and 2, NL 2408.0 EUR and 2, TR 2412.0 EUR and 2, US 1222.25 EUR and 1. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
